title: OCX Global Configuration Schema
description: Schema for the global OCX configuration file at ~/.config/opencode/ocx.jsonc (OCX V2). This config is modified by commands using the --global flag. Registry commands are local-first; --global is required for global writes.

url.description: The base URL of the registry

headers.description: Optional raw HTTP headers. Supports ${ENV_VAR} expansion in global/profile config only (never in a committed local ocx.jsonc).

auth.description: Per-registry authentication. Literal credentials are allowed in any scope; env/file references are honored only in global/profile config, never in a committed local ocx.jsonc.

token.description: Bearer: literal token (allowed in any scope)

tokenEnv.description: Bearer: name of an env var holding the token (global/profile only)

tokenFile.description: Bearer: path to a file containing the token (global/profile only)

password.description: Basic: literal password (allowed in any scope)

passwordEnv.description: Basic: name of an env var holding the password (global/profile only)

passwordFile.description: Basic: path to a file containing the password (global/profile only)

insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for this registry

lockRegistries.description: If true, prevents adding or removing registries via the CLI
